notes: two sayings in one report: after «قال وسمعت عبد الله بن عمر يقول قال رسول الله» the second saying («كل شىء بقدر» from Ibn Umar) has its own isnad after طاوس; I did not add ابن عمر to this route (rule 11)
the tail is written once after the last «ح» and applies to both branches
«فيما قرئ عليه» is a note on the reading, left out
